title: all-hands
text:
all-hands

Raj Patel: Quick ping about next Thursday's all-hands (10am PT). Short format ~30m. Drop 1-2 bullets if you want a slot.

Raj Patel: Proposed agenda:
• 4m — company snapshot + hiring pulse
• 6m — Dedicated launch callouts & SLA highlights (product)
• 7m — runtime perf wins + unit cost notes (eng)
• 5m — customer vignette (CS)
• 8m — Q&A (collected + live)

Emily Wong: Logistics: hybrid room C + Zoom. Live captions on. If you need extra accessibility support DM me. :white_check_mark:

Marco Ruiz: I can show a 60s autoscaler demo for Dedicated during the product segment.

Priya Singh: Will this be recorded? I have a brief piece I need to check before public posting.

Clara Gomez: Recording is enabled by default. Well publish the full recording and a highlighted 2-3min clip to #all-hands-posts. If you need a segment held, flag it before EOD Wed.

Dave Li: Request from eng — include one slide with peak latency numbers + a one-line rollback runbook for oncall.

Raj Patel: Good idea. Dave + Marco, coordinate on the single slide (one chart + one rollback line).

Marco Ruiz: I'll upload the slide and demo clip to the shared drive by Wed COB.

Emily Wong: Slides -> https://drive.reddoc/teams/allhands/briefs . One pager per talk preferred.

Priya Singh: Any policy changes in the exec update? Need to know if comms should prep teams.

Raj Patel: Not a full policy change. We'll mention a minor deployment-review tweak and link to the draft. If approved, comms will follow next week.

Clara Gomez: Q&A collection form: https://forms.reddoc/allhands-questions — top items collected by Wed 5pm.

All-Hands Bot: Reminder set: "All-Hands: Thu 10am PT" will post 24hrs and 1hr before event.

Dave Li: Adding rollback line to slide now.

Marco Ruiz: Slide + clip uploaded Wed evening.

Raj Patel: Thanks all. Keep requests concise. See you Thu. :rocket:
